i Heart Animal Rescue is a 501c3 (non-profit) organization based in South Florida.  We've been working tirelessly the past 7 years, fully staffed by volunteers and fully funded by donations, to rescue South Florida's most vulnerable animals.  We take on medical cases, abuse and the absolute horrors of the rescue world.  We try to get news coverage and spread the word but often throw thousands of dollars into the stabilization and rehabilitation of each animal so a GREAT way to support us is to follow us on social media, repost and share on links on apps like Facebook and Nextdoor and COMMENT  / LIKE / SUBSCRIBE and watch our YouTube videos!  YOU can make the difference, right from your phone! 

Thank you for helping us save lifes!  
Team i Heart
